cases.sentence: На вокзальном перроне меня встречает эта ___ с глазами белого цвета.
cases.translation: On the station platform that girl with white-coloured eyes meets me.
cases.explain: The girl is the one doing the meeting — the subject of «встречает» — and a subject stands in the nominative.
«В» with a verb of motion (answering «куда?») takes the accusative; Петушки is an inanimate plural, so its accusative looks like the nominative.

cases.sentence: В ___ – твое спасение и радость твоя.
cases.translation: In Petushki is your salvation and your joy.
cases.explain: Here «в» answers «где?» — location, not direction — and location with «в» requires the prepositional case.

cases.translation: The borderline between reason and the heart disappeared.
cases.explain: The preposition «между» ('between') governs the instrumental, so both nouns appear as рассудком and сердцем.

cases.sentence: Там даже у тех, кто не просыхает по ___, взгляд бездонен и ясен.
cases.translation: There even those who stay drunk for weeks on end have a bottomless, clear gaze.
cases.explain: «По» with a plural noun meaning a repeated or drawn-out stretch of time takes the dative: по неделям, 'for weeks on end'.

cases.sentence: Он знает букву „ю“ и за это ждет от меня ___.
cases.translation: He knows the letter «ю» and for that he expects nuts from me.
cases.explain: «Ждать» takes the genitive when what is awaited is an indefinite quantity, and «от меня» also requires the genitive form after it.

cases.translation: I will step away for ten minutes.
cases.explain: Numerals from five upwards (десять) are followed by the genitive plural: десять минут.

reading.ru: Я выпил сто пятьдесят и усидел дома?
reading.question: Did Venichka manage to stay at home after drinking the hundred and fifty his reason allowed him?
options: No — he mocks the very idea with a 'ha-ha'
Yes, he stayed in for six days
Yes, but only for one evening
reading.correct: No — he mocks the very idea with a 'ha-ha'
reading.explain: He asks the question rhetorically and answers it himself with «Ха-ха» — of course he did not stay at home.

reading.ru: Я с этого дня пил по тысяче пятьсот каждый день, чтобы усидеть дома, и все-таки не усидел.
reading.question: How much did Venichka drink every day in his effort to make himself stay at home?
reading.explain: He raised the dose from a hundred and fifty to fifteen hundred a day, and still failed to stay put.

reading.ru: В Петушках – твое спасение и радость твоя, поезжай».
reading.question: What did Venichka's reason and heart tell him in one voice once the line between them had vanished?
options: That his salvation and joy are in Petushki, so he should go there
That he should stop drinking at once
That he should stay at home for another six days
That he should look for work
reading.correct: That his salvation and joy are in Petushki, so he should go there
reading.explain: On the sixth day reason and heart merged and both urged him to travel to Petushki.

reading.ru: Первородный грех – может, он и был – там никого не тяготит.
reading.question: What does Venichka say about original sin in Petushki?
reading.explain: He allows that original sin may well have happened, but insists it burdens no one in Petushki.

reading.ru: Там даже у тех, кто не просыхает по неделям, взгляд бездонен и ясен…
reading.question: According to Venichka, what are the eyes like of the people in Petushki who stay drunk for weeks on end?
reading.explain: Even permanent drunkenness does not spoil the gaze of the people in his imagined Petushki.

reading.ru: Пару дохлых портянок и казенные брюки, плоскогубцы и рашпиль, аванс и накладные расходы, – вот что оставил!
reading.question: What does Venichka list as everything he has left behind him?
options: Foot-cloths, work trousers, pliers, a rasp, an advance and overheads
A flat, a wife and two children
His job at the station buffet
reading.correct: Foot-cloths, work trousers, pliers, a rasp, an advance and overheads
reading.explain: He runs through a deliberately worthless inventory of work things to show he is losing nothing by leaving.

reading.ru: А после перрона – зверобой и портвейн, блаженства и корчи, восторги и судороги.
reading.question: What does Venichka expect to come after the platform in Petushki?
options: St John's wort liqueur and port, bliss and convulsions
A long walk to the river
reading.correct: St John's wort liqueur and port, bliss and convulsions
reading.explain: He pairs the drinks with their consequences — raptures and spasms — as one single prospect.

reading.ru: Он знает букву „ю“ и за это ждет от меня орехов.
reading.question: What does Venichka's little son know, and what does he want for it?
options: He knows the letter «ю» and waits for nuts
He knows the whole alphabet and wants a book
He knows a song and wants sweets
He knows nothing yet and wants nothing
reading.correct: He knows the letter «ю» and waits for nuts
reading.explain: The child's single accomplishment is the letter «ю», and his whole reward is a glass of nuts.

reading.ru: Никому; вы и теперь-то ее толком не знаете.
reading.question: What does Venichka say to his listeners about the letter «ю»?
options: That none of them knew it at three, and they hardly know it even now
That all children learn it first
That it is the hardest letter to pronounce
That his son taught it to them
reading.correct: That none of them knew it at three, and they hardly know it even now
reading.explain: He answers his own question — nobody knew it at three — and then needles the listeners about the present.

reading.ru: А пока – вы уж простите меня – пока присмотрите за моим чемоданчиком, я на десять минут отлучусь.
reading.question: What does Venichka ask the angels to do while he is away?
options: Keep an eye on his little suitcase for ten minutes
Hold his place on the bench
Buy him a ticket to Petushki
reading.correct: Keep an eye on his little suitcase for ten minutes
reading.explain: Along with their prayers he asks them for the very practical favour of watching his suitcase.

reading.ru: И вот – я снова встал и через половину вагона прошел на площадку.
reading.question: Where does Venichka go when he gets up again?
options: Through half the carriage to the vestibule
To the buffet in the next station
Back to his old seat by the window
reading.correct: Through half the carriage to the vestibule
reading.explain: He walks through half of the carriage to the end platform of the coach in order to drink there.

highlight.question: Which sentence explains what happened inside Venichka on the sixth day, so that he set off after all?
sentences: Я выпил сто пятьдесят и усидел дома?
Я с этого дня пил по тысяче пятьсот каждый день, чтобы усидеть дома, и все-таки не усидел.

Потому что на шестой день размок уже настолько, что исчезла грань между рассудком и сердцем, и оба в голос мне затвердили: «Поезжай, поезжай в Петушки! В Петушках – твое спасение и радость твоя, поезжай».
highlight.explain: The last sentence gives the cause — the line between reason and heart disappeared and both sent him to Petushki.

highlight.question: Which sentence says that even people who stay drunk for weeks have a clear gaze in Petushki?
sentences: «Петушки – это место, где не умолкают птицы ни днем ни ночью, где ни зимой, ни летом не отцветает жасмин.
Первородный грех – может, он и был – там никого не тяготит.
Там даже у тех, кто не просыхает по неделям, взгляд бездонен и ясен…»
highlight.explain: The third sentence is the one about the gaze of those who never sober up.

highlight.question: Which sentence tells the listeners that they themselves still do not really know the letter «ю»?
sentences: «А там, за Петушками, где сливаются небо и земля, и волчица воет на звезды, – там совсем другое, но то же самое: там в дымных и вшивых хоромах, неизвестный этой белесой, распускается мой младенец, самый пухлый и самый кроткий из всех младенцев.
Он знает букву „ю“ и за это ждет от меня орехов.
Кому из вас в три года была знакома буква „ю“?
Никому; вы и теперь-то ее толком не знаете.
А вот он – знает, и никакой за это награды не ждет, кроме стакана орехов».
highlight.explain: The fourth sentence answers his own question and then turns the mockery on the listeners' present-day knowledge.

highlight.question: Which sentence gives the reason for Venichka's ten-minute absence?
sentences: Да будет светел мой путь, да не преткнусь о камень, да увижу город, по которому столько томился.
А пока – вы уж простите меня – пока присмотрите за моим чемоданчиком, я на десять минут отлучусь.
Мне нужно выпить кубанской, чтобы не угасить порыва».
highlight.explain: The final sentence states the purpose: he must drink kubanskaya so as not to let the impulse die down.
